render_technique.name: ca_dissolved_pixel_focus
render_technique.summary: Chunky black-and-white pixel-art base render, upscaled and edge-relaxed via the project's existing cellular automata engine (fung_ai_v2/ca_engine.py step_ca) as a depth-of-field stand-in: near-zero CA iterations on face regions (stays crisp/focal), progressively more iterations with distance from faces (dissolves into soft organic shapes). Reuses the same CA smoothing already used for cave-wall generation, applied to rendered pixels instead of terrain.

scene_plan_pipeline.summary: Prose breakdowns (scenes/*_breakdown.md) are the human source of truth. Each is captured as a JSON beat sheet (scenes/beatsheets/), and scene_plan_builder.py generates the Godot ScenePlan .tres deterministically. One prose beat expands into several ScenePlan beats -- a camera beat sets framing, action beats drive animation, dialogue beats carry lines, wait beats hold silent time.
scene_plan_pipeline.validation: tests/test_scene_plan_builder.py mirrors ScenePlanValidator's ERROR rules so plans are gated in CI without a Godot binary. All six plans validate with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
scene_plan_pipeline.godot_import_status: unverified -- no Godot binary in the authoring environment. The .tres files are generated against the addon's GDScript @export contracts and checked by test, but have not been opened in the editor.
